props.title: What will be the total amount of military aid (in USD, the form of grants, lend-lease, loans, etc.) provided by the US to Ukraine in 2025?
props.shortTitle: How big will US military support to Ukraine be in 2025?
props.details:
Resolution: This question will close on October 1, 2025. It will be resolved after December 31, 2025, based on official data provided by the US government (State Department, Department of Defense, and/or the Special Inspector General).

Background: The United States is an important security partner for Ukraine. Since the start of the full-scale Russian invasion in February 2022, the United States has provided Ukraine with more than $65 billion in military assistance, according to the Pentagon. As of the end of February 2025, the assistance continues to flow, but there are concerns about the decision to continue it, due to the uncertainty of the new US leadership's position on this issue. Ukraine has already faced a situation where the US suspended assistance for almost seven months in 2023-2024. Then Ukraine was able to hold out, but lost the initiative on the battlefield, and the lack of ammunition led to the fact that the Russians were able to capture Avdiivka, effectively a suburb of Donetsk, which Ukraine had controlled since 20214.
